description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to assist the Recipient in: (a) developing capacity to define needs for developmental projects and programs, and to prepare projects and programs that are suitable for funding by development partners and commercial sources; and (b) commencing the process of developing local technical and professional consulting capacity. To that end, the Project shall provide consulting and advisory services to the Recipient to prepare strategies, projects and programs that meet priority national development needs.
